**Average (median) house price in California (2024)**  
- **Median home value:** ≈ $800 000–$850 000  
- **Average (mean) home value:** ≈ $900 000–$950 000  

> *Sources:*  
> • Zillow Research – “California Home Value Index” (latest 2024 data)  
> • U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey – 2023 housing price estimates  
> • California Association of Realtors – 2024 Market Report  

**Key points**

| Region | Median price (2024) | Notes |
|--------|---------------------|-------|
| San Francisco Bay Area | $1.5 M+ | Highest in state |
| Los Angeles County | $850 k–$950 k | Strong demand, high rents |
| Central Valley | $350 k–$450 k | More affordable |
| Inland Empire | $400 k–$500 k | Growing market |
| Northern California (excluding Bay Area) | $600 k–$750 k | Varied by city |

> The figures above represent the *median* price, which is the most commonly cited metric for “average” home value. The *mean* (average) price is typically higher because a small number of very expensive properties pull the mean upward.  

If you need a more precise number for a specific county or city, let me know!
